notablePrerequisites: You control at least five untapped creatures, one of which must be green.
description:
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by tapping five untapped creatures you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token and returning Sprout Swarm to your hand.
The Saproling enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
